summary: RB Global, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 4, 2026, reporting second quarter 2026 financial results and declaring a quarterly cash dividend of $0.33 per share payable September 17, 2026, to shareholders of record August 25, 2026. The press release discusses operational performance, including GTV and revenue growth, and mentions the acquisition of BigIron, but the filing itself is a routine earnings and dividend announcement. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or strategic review is disclosed. The filing contains standard operational updates and no board recommendation or advisors, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
